title: AI briefing, provenance, feedback and taxpayer-assistance contract
scope: Extend integration/api/openapi.json with a CaseBriefing schema and read operation, an analysis_provenance block on findings, briefings and runs (provider, model id, role, prompt version, fallback level, validation result), an officer finding-feedback operation (accepted/modified/rejected with reason), and taxpayer-scoped assistance operations (explain validation results, document assistance, draft evidence response) whose responses exclude risk scores, internal notes and findings

acceptance.text: Schemas and operations have examples validated by integration/api/contract.py tests; feedback and assistant drafts are idempotent and tenant/taxpayer scoped; taxpayer operations cannot return internal-only fields (negative tests)
docs/API_CONTRACTS.md describes the briefing, provenance, feedback and taxpayer-assistance shapes
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: Contract changes are reviewed by Gupta (AI), Edga (backend), Leseli and Kananelo (frontends); docs/API_CONTRACTS.md describes the briefing, provenance, feedback and taxpayer-assistance shapes

evidence.text: integration/api/openapi.json adds AnalysisProvenance, AiDisclosure, CaseBriefing (getCaseBriefing), FindingFeedback (recordFindingFeedback) and five taxpayer-assistance operations with closed TaxpayerFacing* schemas. python3 integration/api/contract.py: contract valid, 45 HTTP examples (19 new, every new operation has a success example) and 2 events. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts: 113 tests OK, 29 in tests/contracts/test_ai_assistance_contract.py. These cover the lint refusing officer schemas, open objects and internal field names (risk_score, finding_ids, internal_notes, case_id, analysis_provenance, ...) in taxpayer operations; taxpayer responses carrying internal fields or another taxpayer's or tenant's data; feedback replay (same key and body) and conflict (422); actor in body refused; draft unsent until confirmed; confirmation replay; stale second confirmation (409); and missing declaration (400).

Local verification on the PR head (hosted CI blocked by billing): scripts/validate.py passed; scripts/dev.py check passed (LangGraph-dependent AI tests skipped, no .venv-ai); scripts/quality.py passed (ruff, ruff format, mypy, npm run check). Task set IN_REVIEW and human-review PR opened by scripts/task.py finish; criterion 2 (review by Gupta, Edga, Leseli and Kananelo) stays open until they review.

docs/API_CONTRACTS.md section "AI briefing, provenance, feedback and taxpayer assistance (TAX-096)" and the integration/api/README.md operation table, merged in #221.
